name: Finnegan
message: I heard some of th'other men calling her the Lady of Rockfleet Castle last night. Do y'know why?

name: Finnegan
message: She married Sir Richard Burke three years ago today, and divorced him two years ago today.

name: Richard
message: What! Married for only one year? War har har... well, at least it was legitimate in the law's eye.

name: Finnegan
message: That's not all. Th'day she divorced him, she locked herself inside Rockfleet Castle, climbed to the highest window, threw it open...

name: Finnegan
message: An' called out the terms of her divorce!

name: Richard
message: The balls of six bulls, that one.

name: Richard
message: I'll bet she kept all 'is gold too. Isn't that right?

name: Finnegan
message: More'n half of it, by the time the divorce was complete, if I remember correctly.

name: Richard
message: Ruthless, wonderful, terrifying bitch that she is.
